name: tarmoto
description: Tarmoto — Know the road before you ride it

scripts.dev: pnpm shared:build && pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm --parallel --filter @tarmoto/shared --filter @tarmoto/ingest --filter @tarmoto/poi-db --filter @tarmoto/backend --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service --filter @tarmoto/web --filter @tarmoto/companion --filter @tarmoto/admin run dev
scripts.backend:db:migrate: pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm backend:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/backend db:migrate
scripts.openapi:gen: pnpm shared:build && pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/openapi generate
scripts.db:seed: pnpm shared:build && pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm backend:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/backend seed:demo
scripts.poi:import: pnpm shared:build && pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service poi:import
scripts.fsq:import: pnpm shared:build && pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service fsq:import
scripts.poi:load-boundaries: pnpm shared:build && pnpm ingest:build && pnpm poi-db:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ingest-service poi:load-boundaries
scripts.i18n:audit: pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/shared test:i18n && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/ui test && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/backend exec jest --runInBand src/modules/auth/auth.register-language.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/mobile lint && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/mobile exec jest --runInBand && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/companion lint && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/companion typecheck && pnpm --filter @tarmoto/companion test
